BLACK DIAMOND, a new musical will host its first public staged reading (free) Saturday July 25 7:30 pm @ Buckingham Friends School, 5684 York Road, Lahaska, PA 18931 BLACK DIAMOND is a powerful new musical about the plight of Irish immigrants in PA coal country during and after the civil war, who face rampant discrimination, poverty and lethal working conditions in pursuit of the American Dream. This first staged reading/singing features local actors including several CBSD graduates. This free performance will feature live music and will be followed by a Q & A session with the writers, actors and director. The musical explores the rapid industrial growth of the era—where corporate profit frequently came at the expense of human lives—and the questionable legal proceedings that ultimately led to hanging of several miners accused of being Molly Maguires. To reserve tickets please email inspiringthespians@gmail.com – seats are limited! Theater Address: 5684 York Road, Lahaska, Pennsylvania 18931 (Map It) Theater Phone: (215) 431-4012 Theater Amenities: Price: FREE Ticket Reservations: inspiringthespians@gmail.com Buckingham Friends School 0 FacebookTwitterPinterestEmail Patricia Bradford Patricia Bradford holds a Bachelor of Music Degree in Vocal Performance from the New England Conservatory of Music in Boston, Massachusetts. She has performed, directed and produced theatre throughout Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware. Leading STAGE Magazine has become a consuming passion - one which combines her many artistic skills, theatrical contacts, web development and digital marketing abilities. She is thrilled to be carrying on the vision that was begun by Holley Webster, who founded STAGE Magazine as a small theatrical newsletter in the 1970s.
